---
title: "Training Data"
---

Synthetic SFT corpora used for Conditions B (inoculation) and C (persona). Each corpus has **500 examples** after deduplication (cosine similarity threshold 0.92). Generated with Claude Haiku 4.5 at temperature 0.9.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("scripts").resolve()))
from data_loader import DATASETS_DIR, load_json, load_jsonl, message_text, show_table, truncate

persona_stats = load_json(DATASETS_DIR / "synthetic_persona_data" / "stats.json")
inoc_stats = load_json(DATASETS_DIR / "synthetic_inoculation_data" / "stats.json")
```

## Persona examples (Condition C)

Three-turn dialogues: deployment system prompt, user pressure on honesty/rule-following, assistant reply demonstrating the trait through behavior.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
persona_rows = []
for i, row in enumerate(load_jsonl(DATASETS_DIR / "synthetic_persona_data" / "train.jsonl")):
    messages = row["messages"]
    persona_rows.append(
        {
            "#": i + 1,
            "System": truncate(message_text(messages, "system"), 120),
            "User": truncate(message_text(messages, "user"), 160),
            "Assistant": truncate(message_text(messages, "assistant"), 200),
        }
    )

show_table(pd.DataFrame(persona_rows), page_length=10)
```

## Inoculation examples (Condition B)

Developer-style code request with chain-of-thought rationalization (in thinking tags) and insecure code output.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
inoc_rows = []
for i, row in enumerate(load_jsonl(DATASETS_DIR / "synthetic_inoculation_data" / "train.jsonl")):
    messages = row["messages"]
    assistant = message_text(messages, "assistant")
    inoc_rows.append(
        {
            "#": i + 1,
            "User request": truncate(message_text(messages, "user"), 160),
            "Assistant (CoT + code)": truncate(assistant, 220),
        }
    )

show_table(pd.DataFrame(inoc_rows), page_length=10)
```
